list_c_apis_from_files: parse C header files and extract GPRAPI GRPCAPI CENSUSAPI function declarations with return types and arguments
headers_under_directory: recursively walk a directory tree and yield all header files matching the *.h glob pattern
mako_plugin_extract_grpc_apis: extract public headers from grpc and gpr libs in a dictionary and populate c_apis with parsed API data
run_list_api_on_include_dir: run the script to dump all gRPC C API declarations from include/grpc headers as YAML output
review_list_api_regex: review the _RE_API regex pattern that matches GPRAPI GRPCAPI or CENSUSAPI prefixed C function declarations
